name: Heartwood
author: Erin Carter
description: The sawn end of a log: faint dark-on-dark growth rings around an off-centre pith, with fire eating inward from the bark as a wandering annular ember rim graded warm-to-cool. Rings light as hairline preheat circles a beat before they burn; outside is ash with cooling sparks. The rim tightens to the pith and dies as a fresh dark face is already burning in.

params.label: Burn rate
params.effect: How fast the rim collapses toward the pith.

params.label: Rim width
params.effect: Width in CSS px of the annular ember rim.

params.label: Lobe wobble
params.effect: Per-angle lag of the rim; 0 keeps it a perfect shrinking circle.

params.label: Preheat
params.effect: Brightness of the hairline ring that lights each growth ring just before consumption; 0 disables the preview.
